postCreateCommand.install-code-server: curl -fsSL https://code-server.dev/install.sh | sh && code-server --install-extension tabbyml.pochi --install-extension ms-azuretools.vscode-docker --install-extension donjayamanne.githistory --install-extension mhutchie.git-graph --install-extension humao.rest-client --install-extension qcz.text-power-tools --install-extension jebbs.plantuml --install-extension tomoyukim.vscode-mermaid-editor --install-extension dbaeumer.vscode-eslint --install-extension vscjava.vscode-java-pack --install-extension sonarsource.sonarlint-vscode --install-extension redhat.fabric8-analytics --install-extension microsoft.cursor-pgsql

postStartCommand.start-code-server: tmux has-session -t code 2>/dev/null || (tmux new-session -d -s code && tmux send-keys -t code 'code-server --auth none --disable-telemetry --bind-addr 0.0.0.0:7001 /workspaces/ebms' Enter)
postStartCommand.start-openhands: tmux has-session -t canvas 2>/dev/null || (tmux new-session -d -s canvas && tmux send-keys -t canvas 'agent-canvas --port 7000' Enter)
